title: Fibonacci's Liber Abaci
summary: Fibonacci's 'Book of Calculation', among the first Western books on Hindu-Arabic numerals, promoted base-10 place-value notation in Europe.
why: Helped Europe move from Roman numerals to today's digits, a shift that took centuries.

notes.problem: 'Introduced' and 'Europe switched' overstate; source: 'among the first' and abacists persisted for centuries.
